summary: Owner-approved, time-limited elevated credentials (GitHub admin) handed to one child process.

help:
Usage: elevate [-h] {request,status,revoke,run} ...

positional arguments:
  {request,status,revoke,run}
    request             ask the owner (push) for time-limited elevated access
    status              open grants and recent requests
    revoke              end open grants of a kind now
    run                 run a command with the credential in its env: run KIND
                        -- cmd ...

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
help.request:
Usage: elevate request [-h] --reason REASON [--minutes MINUTES]
                        [--requester REQUESTER] [--wait]
                        kind

positional arguments:
  kind

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --reason REASON       what you will do with it, in owner words
  --minutes MINUTES
  --requester REQUESTER
                        agent/session label shown to the owner
  --wait                block until approved/denied (max 15 min)
help.status:
Usage: elevate status [-h]

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
help.revoke:
Usage: elevate revoke [-h] kind

positional arguments:
  kind

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
help.run:
Usage: elevate run [-h] kind ...

positional arguments:
  kind
  cmd

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit

usage.cmd: st elevate request github-admin --reason '<what, in owner words>' --wait; st elevate run github-admin -- gh ...
usage.when: gh 403 'Resource not accessible by personal access token' on repo settings, deploy keys, Actions secrets/variables, profile; = nightshift elevate; also status, revoke github-admin
precautions: reason in owner words; owner approves each 30-min grant by push
use instead of asking the owner to make the change by hand
